summary: EndureGo Tax is a small CPA tax and accounting practice founded in 2006 with offices in Ashfield and Belrose (Sydney) and Adelaide. Director John Cheng FCPA also runs Wistec, a software and Odoo automation company, and posts regularly on LinkedIn about reconciling records before lodging and ERP systems. Its work is tax and BAS-led with bookkeeping from a low weekly fee.

sources.title: EndureGo Tax LinkedIn post: A lodged tax return is a completed task
John Cheng LinkedIn post: Odoo development is finished. What happens next?

claims.text: EndureGo's own site (endurego.com.au) lists an Inner West Sydney office at Suite 18, Level 2, 6 Holden Street, Ashfield NSW 2131, plus Belrose and Adelaide offices.
claims.quote: Suite 18, Level 2, 6 Holden Street Ashfield NSW 2131

claims.text: John Cheng is currently Director of EndureGo Tax (Director - Sydney on the firm's site) and a Fellow of CPA Australia.
John Cheng also founded Wistec, a software development and automation company, and AHA Global, a tech-enabled finance and lending business.
claims.quote: He is the founder of three thriving enterprises: EndureGo, a national CPA accounting firm serving clients in Sydney and Adelaide; Wistec, a software development and automation company

claims.text: EndureGo's 2 Oct 2026 LinkedIn post, signed by John Cheng, tells business owners to check accounting records against bank deposits and payment platforms before lodging.
claims.quote: Check your accounting records against bank deposits and payment platforms.

claims.text: The same post says to investigate inconsistencies between bookkeeping, BAS and annual accounts before lodging.
claims.quote: If your bookkeeping, BAS and annual accounts tell different stories, understand why before lodging.

claims.text: On 25 Aug 2026 John Cheng posted about Odoo implementations, saying the overlooked part is what happens after the system goes live.
claims.quote: One of the most overlooked parts of an Odoo implementation is not the initial development — it is what happens after the system goes live.

claims.text: EndureGo's LinkedIn page says it helps small and medium businesses improve their tax position and reconcile their bookkeeping.
claims.quote: we can help small and medium sized businesses to improve on their tax position, reconcile their bookkeeping

claims.text: EndureGo advertises bookkeeping from $10 per week to help businesses keep accounting in order and maximise their GST position.
claims.quote: Affordable bookkeeping service from $10 per week.

claims.text: John Cheng's LinkedIn lists his role as initiating and implementing system development to improve EndureGo's group performance.
claims.quote: Initiate and implement system development to improve the group performance of EndureGo

claims.text: EndureGo says John Cheng launched the firm in 2006 and Kobe Chen, who joined as a graduate in 2010, is Managing Partner for South Australia.

hooks.text: John's 2 Oct 2026 post lists reconciling income against bank deposits and payment platforms as the first habit before lodging: the step Vert automates.
John builds automation and ERP systems through Wistec and drives system development at EndureGo, so he will respond to a practical workflow and audit-trail conversation.
Bookkeeping is a priced, volume service ($10 per week entry point), where faster reconciliation protects margin.

risks.text: John runs Wistec (software development, ERP and AI) and may prefer to build or integrate his own automation rather than buy; possible competitor or channel partner.
Tax and BAS-led small practice (LinkedIn lists 1-10 employees); virtual CFO positioning from the account record was not found on the firm's own site.
Two emails already sent to John (16 and 23 Nov 2026); avoid repeating earlier angles.

gaps: No podcast, video, Facebook or Instagram appearance found for John Cheng beyond a 2017 Medium post about a News Corporation interview.
No virtual CFO service page found on endurego.com.au despite the account record's service signal.
A sister brand, Wistax (wistax.com.au), uses the same team and offices; the relationship to EndureGo was not confirmed beyond shared staff.
No Xero, MYOB or practice-software partner status found.

followUp.body:
